subject: gk
question: What was the major approach of the Second Five-Year Plan towards industrialisation?

options.text: Focus on infrastructure so as to create employment opportunities in the urban areas
Expansion of the public sector so as to create a base of heavy industry
Focus on mass consumption goods so as to control inflation
Expansion of the cottage industry so as to create employment opportunities in the rural areas

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Second Five-Year Plan** in India was designed with a focus on **industrialization** under the guidance of **P.C. Mahalanobis**, an economist.
 
• It emphasized the development of **heavy industries** and the **public sector** to lay the foundation for long-term economic growth.
